# mtncloud_mos_object_acl (Data Source)

Reads who may read one object in a MOS bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_mos_object_acl" "logo" {
  bucket = "acme-website"
  key    = "logo.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name.
- `key` (String) The object's name.

### Read-Only

- `acl` (String) Its canned ACL, or `custom` when it matches none.
- `grants` (List of String) The grants MOS holds, as `<grantee>:<permission>`.
- `id` (String) `<bucket>/<key>`.
